lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: We only have six hours before the bulldozers turn my classroom into a parking lot [beat] so stop shaking and pick the lock!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: I am a gamer [beat] not a professional cat burglar [beat] and this digital security system is way more advanced than your average locker.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: If we get caught [beat] my parents are going to ground me until I am thirty [beat] and Nix [beat] your dad is the one who called the cops!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: My dad was trapped in the living room [beat] but he won't stay distracted forever [beat] we need those files before he breaks loose and finds us!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You kids shouldn't be here [beat] but since the demolition crew is already at the gate [beat] I suggest you find that hidden safe immediately.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait [beat] the principal is actually helping us? [beat] This feels like a massive trap [beat] or she is just as desperate to save her job as we are.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I knew I would find you here [beat] trying to sabotage the biggest project of my entire career [beat] move away from that desk right now [beat] Nix!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Dad [beat] how did you get out? [beat] You were supposed to be locked at home [beat] you are making a huge mistake with this demolition!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I built this city [beat] and I won't let my own son ruin a multi-million dollar contract [beat] hand over those files or you are grounded for life!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: The folder is empty! [beat] Someone already took the real blueprints [beat] and left us this fake printed receipt for a paper shredder!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: Looking for these? [beat] I always knew this family had too many juicy secrets [beat] and I am selling this scoop to the local news tonight.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Phupu [beat] you are literally betraying your own family for a headline [beat] give those papers back before the first bulldozer starts its engine!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The clock strikes midnight [beat] and the heavy machinery just crushed the school front gate [beat] it might already be too late to stop them.
